scope_note: ACCEPTANCE BUDGETS for the local controlled rig (netns-isolated x0x mesh, pinned release binaries). These are PROPOSED ENGINEERING TARGETS for the mechanism battery, judged against MEASURED results recorded separately in each receipt. They are NOT public-mesh absolute idle-bill figures; the public-mesh capture belongs to the #622 packet. This file is hash-bound into every receipt before the first trial; a changed budget is a new file and a re-run, never a relabel.

infra-seed.description: always-on bootstrap seed (operator-owned, wired/datacenter); carries bootstrap+discovery duty
infra-seed.byte_budget: none (upstream 504-leaf-egress-budget s4.1: no Leaf budget for Full/seed/relay)

relay-full.description: always-on pass-through relay (gossip.relay = true); must relay Critical and revocation
relay-full.byte_budget: none, but total forwarded work is ACCOUNTED in every cost table

desktop-leaf.description: ordinary desktop client (Leaf, moderate subscriptions, targeted traffic)

constrained-leaf.description: mobile/embedded client (W@tch shape: one small CRDT KV store, targeted sync, bounded bursts)

revocation.note: revocation must NEVER be shed by any candidate profile

recovery_gates.bootstrap_removed_degradation: a named degradation receipt is acceptable; silent failure is not
recovery_gates.corrupted_state: fail-closed with a receipt; identity preserved; no partial application

continuity_gates.downgrade_x0xkvs2: fail-closed refusal with no corruption (upstream-documented law; verified, not assumed)
continuity_gates.cold_replacement: recovery from copied state dirs + fresh binary dir alone, no original installation

hostile_bulk_flood.no_resource_runaway: rss/cpu stay within the role budget under a bounded flood

adaptation_gates.verdict_source: kernel veth counters and /proc only; daemon diagnostics are recorded, never verdict sources
